Organization policyPrinciple of Least Privilege: Users and systems should only have the minimum permissions needed to perform their jobs.Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Mandatory for all accounts, particularly administrative ones, to prevent unauthorized access from compromised credentials.Continuous Verification: A "Zero Trust" approach where every access attempt is verified regardless of its origin. 2.
